# Bundled browser PDF dependencies

- jsPDF 4.2.1, official npm `jspdf` UMD build, MIT (jspdf-LICENSE.txt).
- PDF.js 5.4.624, official npm `pdfjs-dist` browser module and matching worker, Apache 2.0 (pdfjs-LICENSE.txt).
- DejaVu Sans regular/bold from the installed Matplotlib distribution; license in DejaVu-LICENSE.txt.

Loaded locally on demand. No worksheet content is uploaded to a service.
